rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server by Marlene Mhangami provides automated guidance for publishing MCP servers to the registry through a specialized prompt that evaluates the best publishing approach for a given server. Built with FastMCP and featuring integration with the official MCP registry documentation, it offers expert recommendations on automated CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, validates server.json schemas, and guides users through both automated and manual publishing processes. The implementation includes a complete GitHub Actions workflow for PyPI and MCP registry publishing with OIDC authentication, making it valuable for MCP server developers who need streamlined publishing workflows and best practice guidance for getting their servers into the official registry.
